verdict.rationale: Blink Shell clearly supports multiple shells (two-finger tap to create new shells, swipe to switch), themes/fonts customization, and persistent Mosh sessions that survive sleep, which together support multiple independent sessions. However, there's no explicit evidence of per-session distinct 'context' persistence (e.g., separate history per shell) or per-shell appearance customization, only global theme settings, and no evidence addresses per-shell history isolation.
